Pacers are starting Tyrese Haliburton, Ben Sheppard, Kelly Oubre, Pascal Siakam, and Ivica Zubac in OKC. So, yes, Haliburton is playing and returning to the Paycom center for the first time since Game 7 of the 2025 Finals.

Not announced, but would assume Nesmith + Nembhard out.
